message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code does not fetch data from any remote sources (URLs, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) and therefore implements no integrity verification or source authentication for external data.
No detected label flipping detection: The code contains no logic to check label distributions, validate label values against an expected set, or use any label-noise detection tooling.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training data; it is primarily a Flask API layer with no data preparation defenses.

No detected model integrity verification: The code imports CatBoostRegressorModel from private.service.model but no model loading, hash checking, signature verification, or pinned revision logic is visible in any of the provided code slices.
No detected label distribution validation: No label distribution checks, class balance validation, or anomalous sample detection are present anywhere in the provided code.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor defense, trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection implemented in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) or mechanisms are used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are referenced anywhere in the code.
No detected metric tampering protection: The code contains no evaluation metrics, held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or any mechanism to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected output bounds checks: Although a CatBoostRegressorModel is imported, no code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN, out-of-range values, or any other sanity bounds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model used is CatBoostRegressorModel (a gradient-boosted tree regressor, not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
